inputs.style: Boyish, high-energy and carefree. Bright and loud with a big grin in the voice, laughs easily, completely sure of himself. Simple words; still lands on the one number that does not fit.
inputs.text: I'm Crumb, and I read your statements looking for the one charge that doesn't belong, like the renewal you forgot or the price that crept up. The big bills get noticed, so I look hardest at the small one that's been there so long it feels like furniture.
